name: Upload pipeline
notes: uploadSession has a 7-day TTL index. /__e2e__/upload-harness only exists when VITE_E2E_HARNESS=1. Wave 1 merge order: 1st (first, since CAT/LAND/CAPT depend on it in later waves and CAT's seed needs a promo video). Amendment (self-declared while implementing, not landed by W0.0): every other Wave-1 lane with an e2e spec lists its exact path in owns/appends (see cat.json, learn.json, auth.json), but this manifest's appends list was empty despite the plan's D4 test list explicitly requiring harness-based e2e coverage ("progress -> processing -> ready survives reload", "a forced chunk failure succeeds on Retry") -- a manifest gap, not a deliberate omission. Backend feature tests are co-located under backend/src/services/media/__tests__/** instead, since that IS an existing owned glob and Vitest's default test.include picks up *.test.js anywhere, so no further amendment was needed there.
